description: This file is the main root layout component for a Remix-run-based React application. It includes imports for core remix and React modules, defines a loader for environment variables and authentication status, and contains the main app layout including header, sidebar, and outlet for nested routes.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Loads environment variables and authentication status from cookies, providing data to the app via Remix loader data.

methods.name: Layout
methods.description: Main layout component rendering HTML structure, including meta tags, styles, and scripts for the application.

methods.name: TopNav
methods.description: Navigation header component showing the app title, API endpoint, and login/logout link.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Root component that manages overall application layout, including conditional rendering of sidebar and main outlet.
